purpose: Advance R1 without inventing site-level feasibility: freeze the focal taxon, prospective transport taxon, independence logic and block-scale admission rules before a final site registry or focal reproductive outcomes exist.

priority_revision.basis: Outcome-blind R1b occurrence, geographic-independence and regulatory-friction screening before focal reproductive outcomes.

focal_context.geographic_family: Izu populations with source-resolved historical and contemporary context
focal_context.reason_for_candidate_pair: The pair spans the source-defined Oshima versus post-Oshima ecological contrast and is already represented in the regional evidence architecture; final admission still requires prospective site-, plant-, SVD- and treatment-feasibility screening.
focal_context.first_reconnaissance_priority: Oshima named localities because multiple source-backed occurrence leads are already resolved there
focal_context.seasonal_window_role: summer flowering window; exact dates remain a site-level R1 feasibility item and cannot be selected from reproductive outcomes

transport_context.role: second prospective independent natural context for NEE breadth
transport_context.selection_basis: Source-defined pollen-success target membership plus high interaction breadth and broad source-site coverage; selection does not use focal Chapter-2 reproductive effect direction.
transport_context.preferred_geographic_family: Kozushima as the first-priority transport geography because it provides a second island geography relative to Oshima-first focal reconnaissance and has a source-backed Farfugium locality lead; exact experimental admission remains open.
transport_context.mainland_contingency_rule: Use the historical Hiraiwa-Ushimaru mainland source-site universe only if the Kozushima transport candidate fails frozen access, permit, phenology, abundance or block-independence gates before focal outcomes; do not switch because of focal effect direction.
transport_context.same_archipelago_fallback_rule: A same-archipelago Farfugium context is admissible only if taxon, season, geography and sampling units make it a genuine prospective transport challenge rather than another Campanula focal block.
transport_context.seasonal_window_role: autumn flowering window; exact dates remain a site-level R1 feasibility item
transport_context.P6_primary_target: transport the frozen H2 plant-state x effective-community mapping without retuning
transport_context.H5_transport_role: record and apply the same outcome-blind dependence coordinate and aggregation rules; independent decisive H5 power in the transport context is required only if R3 declares it feasible and necessary for the final Stage-1 claim set

block_architecture.block_definition: prespecified taxon x population/site x time window
block_architecture.focal_H5_design_lever: independent repeated blocks, not flowers or visits

prepilot_screen_reference_only.note: Synthetic order-of-magnitude screen only; not empirical power and not a final sample-size rule.

block_architecture.R1_screening_floor: A focal scope with materially fewer than 32 plausibly independent repeated blocks is not preferred for the NEE H5 lane unless R2/R3 later supply stronger empirical information; do not count within-plant flowers, visits or SVD repeats as independent blocks.
block_architecture.dependence_requirement: R1 must create observable variation in outcome-blind shared-dependence/synchronization across repeated effective-community opportunities; low/high labels or a continuous interaction are frozen from exposure data before reproductive outcomes.

exact_R1_closure_requirements: name the actual focal Campanula population/site units rather than island labels alone
name the actual Farfugium transport population/site units
show each admitted site has enough eligible flowering plants for the pilot chain
predeclare time-window construction and demonstrate that nominal blocks are not simple pseudoreplicates
show SVD background controls and all three reproductive treatments are feasible in both contexts
show the planned block schedule can estimate the outcome-blind dependence coordinate before reproductive outcomes are opened
record access/permit/phenology exclusion reasons without using effect direction

route_logic.if_focal_scope_can_support_H5_and_transp: continue NEE Stage-1 lane to R2
route_logic.if_focal_scope_is_strong_but_transport_c: single-system EL/Ecology lane; do not weaken H5 or back-promote old metadata to P6
route_logic.if_focal_scope_cannot_supply_independent: do not close R1 for NEE; keep H1-H4 confirmatory and reserve full H5 for an expanded design

forbidden: declare Oshima and Kozushima final sites only because they are logistically convenient
call seasonal or within-site repeated rows independent geographic replication
choose or switch Farfugium transport geography after seeing focal outcome direction
use synthetic rho values as natural dependence cutoffs
use the prepilot operating-characteristic screen as empirical power
reduce H5 requirements after pilot investment to preserve an NEE label
claim_boundary: R1 architecture is frozen at the taxon, priority-geography and block-rule level, but R1 is not closed until actual population/site units and time windows pass prospective feasibility. The 2026-09-13 transport-priority revision used only pre-outcome occurrence, independence and regulatory information.
